correctness.rationale: With total length normalized to one, integrating |x−y| on the pendant square, the shorter circular distance on the loop square, and x+y on the two mixed rectangles reproduces both moment polynomials. Separate exact integration also verifies the stated collision example. The derivative of H is −t[10(t−3/4)²+3/8]/30, strictly negative on (0,1); the endpoint limits give the claimed open range. The sign change of μ′=t(5t−4)/4 distinguishes all mean fibers, excluding the unattainable shape endpoint t=1 when μ=1/4. Integration of −H′ gives H(t)−H(s)≥(s²−t²)/160 for 0<t<s<1 and ≥δ(s−t)/80 for t,s≥δ. The comparison of t=ε and s=2ε makes both input differences O(ε²), excluding any larger uniform inverse exponent. H in its range alone is not sufficient for consistency of a measured pair. The uploaded code was read, not executed; exact integrals and the collision can be replayed in review_checks.py, lollipop().
